name: MS MARCO: Microsoft Machine Reading Comprehension
description: MS MARCO (Microsoft Machine Reading COmprehension) is a large-scale information retrieval and question answering dataset comprising 1,010,916 real search queries sampled from Bing search logs, paired with 8.8 million web passages extracted from relevant search result documents. Developed by Microsoft AI & Research, it is the primary academic benchmark for dense retrieval, re-ranking, and open-domain question answering.

provenance.curation_notes: Human annotators drafted comprehensive natural language answers only when evidence was verified in the retrieved web passages.
